purpose: Stable machine-readable invariants for the post-D6 release finalizer. Values here are CURRENT REPOSITORY FACTS and expected counts only. No provisional archive identity is recorded as the RELEASED identity: the finalizer derives the values it replaces from the tracked package record and recomputes the values it writes from the final archive bytes. The pre-D6 candidate is pinned only as a TECHNICAL SOURCE, explicitly labelled as such.

trusted_contract.note: Production loads the contract from exactly this tracked path inside the verified worktree and requires the on-disk bytes to equal the git blob at the expected HEAD. The production CLI has NO --contract option: an operator cannot point the finalizer at an external file that redefines the required login, the authorization text, the licensed assets or the activation scope. Unit tests inject contracts by passing a dict to the Python functions, which is not a production surface. This block deliberately does NOT record the contract's own hash - a file cannot pin its own digest without circularity - so identity is verified against git, not against a constant stored here.
trusted_contract.expected_head_note: While the finalizer repair is uncommitted, the on-disk contract differs from the blob at HEAD and production preflight reports CONTRACT_NOT_AT_HEAD by design. Once the repair is committed the two agree and the code no longer fires.

authorization.source: EITHER of the two discriminated approval sources declared in approval_sources. The PREFERRED professional route is external_evidence: a preserved complete approval email, or a signed approval form, recorded in a tracked approval record and verified byte-for-byte against the original evidence file. The github_pr_comment route is retained, fully isolated and OPTIONAL. Dr. Najibi is never asked to operate GitHub or to run any tooling.
authorization.matching_rule: EXACT EQUALITY of the whitespace-normalized approval text against the whitespace-normalized text below. Substring containment is forbidden: the required paragraph plus any prefix, suffix, qualification or revocation is NOT authorization. The same rule governs a GitHub comment body and the approved_text of an external approval record.
authorization.text: I, Nasser Najibi, confirm that I am a copyright holder of the jointly created SCORCH Figure 1 and Figure 4 schematic artwork and authorize the SCORCH project to license the seven Figure 1 and Figure 4 artwork files identified by path and SHA-256 in the accompanying approval record under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence (CC BY 4.0), including the permissions for sharing and adaptation provided by that licence. This authorization does not include unrelated SCORCH figures and does not alter the rights or licences of the software, fonts, or underlying third-party data.

approval_sources._note: The TWO discriminated sources a coauthor approval may arrive by. Exactly one of them supplies any given finalization, and which one is recorded in the receipt as approval_source, so the durable evidence always says how the permission was obtained. external_evidence is the PREFERRED professional route and is the authors' chosen workflow: Dr. Najibi replies to an email or signs a form, and nothing further is asked of them - no GitHub account, no command, no tooling. github_pr_comment is retained because it is already built and tested, but it is NO LONGER MANDATORY and nothing in the release requires it.

external_evidence._note: A two-part evidence chain, neither half of which is sufficient alone. (1) The ORIGINAL approval - the complete email with its full headers, or the signed form as scanned - stays OUTSIDE the repository, because raw headers carry personal routing data and a signature image is a signature. (2) A tracked approval record inside the repository states, in the clear, what was approved and by what evidence: source type, approval date, the exact approved paragraph, the seven path -> SHA-256 identities, and the original evidence's own SHA-256 and byte count, under the custodian's attestation. Finalization requires BOTH: it re-reads the original evidence file from wherever the custodian keeps it, hashes it, and refuses unless those bytes are exactly the ones the tracked record commits to. A record without its evidence proves nothing, and evidence without a tracked record is not auditable years later from the repository alone.
external_evidence.attestation_statement: I, Fawaz Bouhamad, am the custodian of the original approval evidence identified in this record. I received it directly from Dr. Nasser Najibi, I have preserved it complete and unaltered outside this repository, and the approved paragraph recorded here is a verbatim copy of the paragraph that evidence contains.

github_pr_comment._note: The original route, unchanged and fully isolated behind find_authorization. Retained and tested; never required. If it is ever used the receipt records approval_source github_pr_comment and the comment fields exactly as before.
github_pr_comment.enabled_note: Selecting this route is the SCORCH authors' choice, never a task for Dr. Najibi.

authorization_receipt.note: The durable machine-readable record of the coauthor approval, whichever of the two approval_sources supplied it; approval_source in the receipt says which. It MUST NOT exist in the real repository until a valid approval has been resolved during a real finalization - from a tracked approval record verified against its original external evidence, or from a live pull request comment. It is built and validated inside the disposable validation copy and written atomically as part of the same transaction as the licence and identity edits; if any part of the transaction fails, the receipt is removed again. A stdout report is not a receipt.
authorization_receipt.source_discriminator_note: A receipt written by an external-evidence finalization carries approval_source = external_evidence and the field set below INSTEAD of the GitHub comment fields, because there is no comment: a permalink and a comment id would be fabricated. A receipt with no approval_source at all is read as github_pr_comment, which is what every receipt written before this route existed would have been.

validation_copy._note: The disposable validation tree is an INDEPENDENT CLONE at the expected head plus this allowlist, never a copy of the worktree. A shutil.copytree minus four names swept in every ignored artifact in the checkout - editor scratch, stale outputs, half-written downloads - and reproduced SYMLINKS as symlinks; copying tracked worktree BYTES then admitted any transient mutation the checkout happened to be holding while the copy was taken; and copying .git as a directory could not work at all in a linked worktree, where .git is a file, which is how this repository is checked out. The tree is therefore cloned with git from committed objects and checked out at the exact expected head, and the clone's head, tracked set and tree identity are verified before the planned activation and receipt edits are applied. Every entry here is an ignored artifact the suite genuinely needs, pinned by SHA-256; an entry without a pin is refused, and so is one whose bytes do not match. The list is EMPTY on purpose: publication_outputs/ is regenerated by the suite from the extracted final archive rather than inherited from the operator's working copy, which is what makes the validation run a test of the release instead of a test of the developer's desk.

trusted_interpreter._note: DELIBERATELY UNPINNED. Production finalization runs sys.executable - the interpreter already running the finalizer - and the CLI has no --python option. The release is accepted on a validator verdict and a pytest summary, and both are simply the standard output of whichever executable was named; a wrapper that prints 'PASS' and a clean JSON summary is a two-line script. If a different interpreter ever has to be used, its realpath and/or sha256 go here and _pinned_interpreter_issues verifies them; with neither field present any non-default interpreter is refused as INTERPRETER_UNTRUSTED. Unit tests pass sys.executable, which is the default and needs no pin.

artwork_licence_markers._note: EXACT artwork-rights markers. Classification used to scan whole documents for broad words - 'prohibited', 'must not', 'may not', 'no CC BY' - which matched legitimate unrelated text: a 'prohibited-region invariance' note, or a sentence saying the underlying ERA5 data carries no CC BY licence. That made the artwork look PENDING for reasons having nothing to do with the artwork, and would have made a correct activation impossible to complete. Only the exact strings below decide the artwork's state, and only within the five licence surfaces. Every unrelated ERA5, GHCN, Natural Earth, software and font restriction is untouched by this classification.
pending: licensing is PENDING and not yet in force
EXCLUDED FROM THE CC BY 4.0 ENTRY
active: The Figure 1 and Figure 4 slide artwork is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence (CC BY 4.0).

protected_historical_record_identities._note: THREE DISTINCT IDENTITIES, deliberately not conflated. git_blob_* is the portable repository identity (LF, what every platform checks out from). worktree_sha256/worktree_bytes are a NON-PORTABLE observation of this Windows checkout, where .gitattributes 'text=auto eol=lf' produced CRLF working-tree bytes. A Windows checkout hash must never be presented as a portable git-blob identity. eol_relationship records the proven relationship: applying CRLF->LF to the worktree bytes reproduces the blob exactly, with zero lone CR bytes. The transaction snapshots the ACTUAL CURRENT BYTES (whatever the platform checked out) and separately verifies the tracked git blob.

technical_source_candidate.note: The corrected pre-D6 candidate is the TECHNICAL SOURCE the finalizer extracts and rebuilds from. It is a local, unpublished, pre-D6 working artifact. It is NOT the released archive identity - the released identity is recomputed from the final archive bytes after the licence transition, manifest regeneration and deterministic rebuild. It is NOT evidence of publication or deposit, and nothing may cite it as such. It is never itself shipped, renamed to the release filename, or given a DOI.

superseded_official_archive.note: The archive the tracked records currently point at. It carries a superseded NetCDF payload. The finalizer never writes to it, never deletes it and never uses it as a build source; its explicit path, SHA-256 and byte count are verified during preflight AND immediately before the write, and it must be byte-identical and present after a successful finalization as well as after a failed one. CRITICAL: the released archive has the SAME FILENAME, so a release-staging destination resolving to this path would destroy it. That collision is refused with RELEASE_DESTINATION_COLLIDES_WITH_SUPERSEDED; the operator must supply a different --release-staging directory.

contract_identity_exemption._note: This file is the ONE tracked file that legitimately names an archive identity without being part of the identity replacement map. It must name the superseded archive it preserves and the pre-D6 technical source it rebuilds from, and both are named by digest. The exemption that lets it do so is FIELD-level and is not a licence for this file: only the exact dotted paths listed below may hold an identity digest, the value at such a path must BE the digest rather than merely contain it, and an identity anywhere else in this file - a sibling field inside one of these blocks, a note, an object key, or a copy hidden in a duplicate key that JSON parsing drops - is reported as IDENTITY_MAPPING_MISMATCH exactly as it would be in any other tracked file. The four permitted PATHS are pinned in release_finalizer.py (CONTRACT_IDENTITY_EXEMPT_FIELDS, from which CONTRACT_IDENTITY_EXEMPT_ROOTS is derived), not here: the declaration below must equal that set exactly, with no repeats and no fifth entry, so editing this contract cannot widen the exemption over 'identity', over a current-release pointer, or over a newly invented sibling inside one of these two blocks. Each of the four declared digests is itself scanned through the whole document, keys included, and permitted only at its own registered path. This file is deliberately NOT in identity.files: a finalization rewrites every file in that map, and these records exist to state historical and candidate fact.

publication_outputs_artwork_row._note: The Figure 1 / Figure 4 row emitted into publication_outputs/README.md. Both wordings live HERE, in the trusted tracked contract, so the builder serves authored prose rather than inventing it. Both are AUTHORED: activating CC BY rewrites a legal claim about a coauthor's copyright, that prose is the authors' to write, and it has now been written. AUTHORED IS NOT AUTHORIZED. The builder still emits the PENDING row, because which row it serves is decided by the repository's actual licence state - receipt present and valid, or not - and never by the fact that active wording exists. Were 'active' left empty the builder would refuse to render an active row at all, exactly as the finalizer refuses an unauthored activation plan.
publication_outputs_artwork_row.pending: | `assets/frozen_figures/**` (Fig. 1, 4) | CC BY 4.0 PENDING -- not yet in force; requires written authorization from coauthor Dr. Nasser Najibi |
publication_outputs_artwork_row.active: | `assets/frozen_figures/fig01/**`, `assets/frozen_figures/fig04/**` (Fig. 1, 4) | The Figure 1 and Figure 4 slide artwork is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence (CC BY 4.0). |

release_test_collection._note: The frozen release test collection. A release run must collect EXACTLY this sorted node-ID set: the count and the SHA-256 of the newline-joined sorted node IDs must both match, and the executed set must equal the collected set. This is what makes 'everything passed' mean 'everything ran'. Regenerate deliberately whenever tests are added or removed - never to make a red run go green.
release_test_collection._refrozen: Refrozen at 4D-r3o, the structural provenance reorganization. The retained correction-evidence packet moved from remediation/ to provenance/corrections/tmax_weighted_centroids/ and the legacy Figure 9 pointer directory from legacy_defective_figure09/ to provenance/legacy/figure09/, every moved file proven byte-identical before and after the move; no scientific value, archive identity, licence state, approval state or receipt state changed, and the two byte-preserved historical freeze manifests kept their pinned blob and worktree identities under their new paths. 8 node IDs added and 5 removed, all in tests/test_public_consistency_guards.py and tests/test_release_finalizer.py: five of the additions are the same parametrized tests whose IDs carry the relocated evidence paths (the five removals are their old-path spellings), and three are new pinned repository-layout guards - the exact tracked root directory and root file sets, the complete 23-file provenance evidence set, and a zero-tolerance scan for retired-path references outside a pinned per-file historical allowlist that permits only immutable archive-member names, pre-relocation crosswalk keys and byte-preserved historical records. 1258 - 5 + 8 = 1261 reproduces the previous frozen count exactly, which is what makes 'nothing else changed' a measurement instead of a claim. Recompute ONLY through the finalizer summary plugin, for the reason recorded below. PRIOR HISTORY: the 1258 set was frozen at 4D-r3n, a narrow final repair of three things r3m left. (1) THE ACTIVE PUBLICATION ROW IS PATH-EXACT AND IS READ FOR ITS SCOPE. It wrote assets/frozen_figures/**, an undeclared glob reaching everything under that directory, and now names the two declared scopes exactly - assets/frozen_figures/fig01/** and assets/frozen_figures/fig04/**. It had survived because the row was checked for its DIGEST and its MARKER and never for what its scope token identified as Licensed Material: it was the one licence surface the semantic guard never saw, and it is the surface published to readers of publication_outputs/README.md. Its reviewed digest is repinned in REVIEWED_PUBLICATION_ROW_ACTIVE, and _assert_publication_row_scope now reads it. A row is judged WHOLE rather than split into sentences, because _sentences breaks on the full stop in '(Fig. 1, 4)', which puts the scope cell in one fragment and the CC BY clause in another - so a sentence-scoped check sees a scope with no licence beside it and a licence with no scope, and passes. That is exactly how the broad glob survived, and running the ordinary prose guard over the row would not have caught it either. The pending row stays broad on purpose: it is a DENIAL, and withholding over a wider area grants nothing. (2) ROOT-ANCHORED PATHS ARE REFUSED, NEVER NORMALIZED. A POSIX-absolute path (/assets/...), a home-prefixed path (~/assets/...) and a UNC/network path (//host/share/..., backslash-backslash host) are each refused as themselves in affirmative licensing prose, on fresh grants and on denial-to-grant flips alike. The defect was in the TOKENIZER rather than the classifier: the token pattern required a match to begin with a word character, so in /assets/frozen_figures/fig01/Figure_01.png the match began AFTER the slash and the classifier was handed a registered repository path and correctly answered 'claims nothing'. No amount of care in _scope_token_claim could have seen it. The pattern now matches these forms including their leading marker, with a lookbehind so that 'and/or' and the '//' inside an https:// deed URL are not swept up. This REVERSES a previously asserted behaviour: /assets/frozen_figures/fig01/Figure_01.png used to be accepted as merely another spelling of the registered file, on the reasoning that separator style is not a licensing question. A LEADING separator is not separator style - it names a path from the filesystem root, from a home directory, or on another machine - so that parametrization moved from the accepted list to a refusal, deliberately and with the reasoning recorded in the test. (3) THE DURABLE GUARD READS THE RECORD ITSELF. Validation of an external receipt now requires the committed approval record's own schema_version, its full mandatory field set, an allowed source_type, and evidence whose filename format is consistent with that source_type - checked on the RECORD, not merely on its agreement with the receipt, because a malformed record and a receipt that faithfully repeats the same defect satisfied every durable check between them. One canonical EVIDENCE_FORMATS map now lives in artwork_licence_state and is re-exported by release_finalizer, so the finalization path and the durable guards cannot drift. 29 node IDs added and 0 removed, all in tests/test_release_finalizer.py, which goes from 683 to 712; the 546 node IDs in every other test file are untouched, and 546 + 683 = 1229 reproduces the previous frozen count exactly. Collected node IDs carry NO duplicates, so the uniquely-sorted digest and the plainly-sorted digest are the same value - which matters because frozen_collection_issues hashes sorted(collected) without deduplicating. PRIOR HISTORY: the 1229 set was frozen at 4D-r3m, when the four integration blockers the 4E1d checkpoint left open were closed. (1) APPROVAL-SOURCE SELECTION IS NOW REAL: preflight validated the GitHub comment route unconditionally, so a repository holding a valid committed approval record - the route the authors actually intend to use - still reported RELEASE_BLOCKED_D6 for want of a comment nobody was going to post. Both modes now call one selector, select_approval_source, which decides from observable state: a committed record IS the professional route and no comment is consulted, asked for or required; with no record the comment route is used only if enabled; with neither, RELEASE_BLOCKED_D6 means precisely that neither enabled route qualifies. PR metadata is still verified through GitHub on either route, but the comment authorization methods are unreachable on the external route, proved by a production preflight test and a full external-route finalize e2e whose issue_comments and issue_comment raise if touched. (2) THE EXTERNAL RECEIPT IS INTEGRATED: reporting is source-aware, so the finalization no longer raised KeyError indexing comment_id on a receipt that has none - after the archive had already been built - and an external receipt is now refused unless the tracked approval record it rests on is present, tracked at HEAD, byte-equal to its committed blob, and agrees with the receipt on the recomputed SHA-256 and git blob identity, the approved paragraph, the seven-artwork scope, the evidence metadata and the custodian attestation. That check runs on EVERY receipt read - builder, guards and finalizer - because the builder and the guards are exactly the callers a hand-written receipt was aimed at; absent-record, untracked, locally-modified, wrong-blob, wrong-content and hand-written adversaries all fail to reach ACTIVE. (3) THE LEGAL SCOPE IS PINNED IN CODE: REVIEWED_CCBY_ARTWORK_IDENTITIES pins the seven repository path -> SHA-256 identities and REVIEWED_CCBY_SCOPE_GLOBS the five declared directory scopes, and all four contract surfaces that claim to state that scope - ccby_artwork_paths, the figures entries for those paths, ccby_activation_plan.scope.assets and ccby_artwork_scope_globs - must equal them, checked in the loader so that adding, removing, renaming or changing any identity fails before an approval is sought and before any activation is planned. The production loader now refuses the synthetic_fixture key in ANY form, false and null as surely as true, because that one key switches off the reviewed-prose pins, the scope pins and the synthetic-wording refusal together (this note deliberately does not spell the fixture marker token, which the tracked contract may never contain); the end-to-end fixtures reach it only through a keyword-only, default-off Python argument that no CLI flag, environment variable or contract field can set. Artwork paths that are POSIX-absolute, UNC, drive-absolute, home-prefixed or upward-traversing are refused, since joining them onto the repository root discards the root; affirmative grants naming a DOCX, PPTX or XLSX are refused rather than treated as citations, because a manuscript is an authored work carrying publisher and third-party rights the authors do not hold; and a declared dir/** must contain the registered works and nothing else - not a README, a caption, an extensionless file, a subdirectory, or any symlink, junction or special object. (4) THE TRUST MODEL IS STATED HONESTLY: the software proves the committed record, the evidence file's identity by digest and length, the hashes, the scope and the internal consistency of record and receipt, and it requires the declared source type to be consistent with the preserved file's format; it does NOT authenticate handwriting, an email sender or human intent, and no longer implies that it does. Fawaz Bouhamad's custodian attestation supplies that human provenance, and the original evidence is preserved outside the repository. Both the record and the evidence are now read through the component-safe, no-follow, opened-handle walk that already protected the receipt - the record anchored at the repository root, the evidence at its volume root - so a junction on a parent directory is refused where a leaf-only O_NOFOLLOW open saw nothing, and containment failures fail closed with no fallback to a plain open. The scope pins are enforced at THREE sites, not one - the loader, preflight and plan_ccby_activation - because preflight and the planner both accept a contract they were handed, and what an activation grants is decided in the planner; the prose pins were already checked in all three. 75 node IDs added and 0 removed, all in tests/test_release_finalizer.py, which goes from 608 to 683; the 546 node IDs in every other test file are untouched, and 546 + 608 = 1154 reproduces the previous frozen count exactly, which is what makes 'nothing else changed' a measurement instead of a claim. Recompute ONLY through the finalizer summary plugin: parametrized IDs in test_xlsx_equivalence_guardrails carry embedded XML, so any line-based scrape of --collect-only output risks reproducing the right COUNT and a wrong DIGEST, which reads as drift when nothing drifted. PRIOR HISTORY: the 1154 set was frozen at 4D-r3l, when the CC BY prose guard stopped being the authority on what the activation grants. The reviewed activated wording of all five licence surfaces, the active publication row, the ACTIVE marker and the approval paragraph itself are now pinned BY SHA-256 in REVIEWED_ACTIVATION_DESTINATIONS and its three companions in scripts/release/release_finalizer.py, so a contract edit that changes any of them - by an eighth artwork path, a widened class, a deleted exclusion, or one character - is refused as CCBY_ACTIVATION_DESTINATION_UNREVIEWED without any pattern having anticipated it. That was necessary because the r3k prose guard was measured and found fail-open: over eight ways of widening the grant, in two forms each, it ACCEPTED 11 of 16, and it accepted every one of the eight when an existing DENIAL was rewritten into a grant, because it counted sentences that merely MENTIONED CC BY and a denial and a grant are both such a sentence. The prose guard survives underneath the pins with three repairs, each of which was one of those bypasses: polarity is part of the counting key and is decided narrowly and fail-CLOSED, so an unrecognised sentence and a sentence that both grants and denies are read as grants; identity is path-exact against complete normalized repository paths, and a URL or a drive-absolute path is never folded onto a registered one; and coverage refuses what it cannot place, so an unrecognised image extension and a bare directory glob are findings rather than silence, a glob being accepted only where ccby_artwork_scope_globs declares it AND the tree confirms nothing but registered artwork lives under it. The same checkpoint corrected the LEGAL MEANING the guard was defending: CC BY 4.0 permits reproduction, technical format changes and adaptation of the Licensed Material, so every statement that a cropped, resized, recoloured or recomposed version is 'outside the grant' was wrong about the licence and was removed from the contract, all five destination blocks, the publication row, the operator guide and the review packet; what stays bounded is WHICH WORKS are Licensed Material, namely the seven identified by path and SHA-256. And it added a second, discriminated approval source so that Dr. Najibi is never asked to operate GitHub: a preserved approval email or a signed approval form, recorded in a tracked-at-HEAD approval record and verified byte-for-byte against the original evidence kept outside the repository, with the receipt carrying approval_source, the record's blob id and digest, and the evidence's digest and length. The GitHub comment route is retained, isolated and no longer mandatory. 80 node IDs added and 0 removed. Proved rather than assumed: deleting exactly those additions and restoring exactly those removals reproduces the previous frozen set byte for byte (1074 / 7196a29a...), which is what makes 'nothing else changed' a measurement instead of a claim. Recompute ONLY through the finalizer summary plugin: parametrized IDs in test_xlsx_equivalence_guardrails carry embedded XML and newlines, so any line-based scrape of --collect-only output reproduces the right COUNT and a wrong DIGEST, which reads as drift when nothing drifted. PRIOR HISTORY: the 1074 set was frozen at 4D-r3k, when CCBY_SCOPE_UNREGISTERED_ASSET stopped comparing BASENAMES and began comparing complete normalized repository paths: 50 added, 7 renamed away. That set was refrozen from 1031 / f6fe9b62... at 4D-r3j, when the deposit's own LICENSE.txt transition became a byte-level splice with a pinned +2 line delta: 42 added, nothing renamed or removed. The 1031 set came from 989 / f6a88d6c... at 4D-r3i, when the identity exemption was narrowed to the exact four pinned paths: 34 added, nothing renamed or removed. The 989 set came from 955 / 25558c12..., that from 929 / 41a47c93... when the field-level exemption gained its focused tests, and that from 906 / ea2dc098... when the authored CC BY activation plan gained its tests.

ccby_artwork_scope_globs_note: Directory scopes the authored licence tables are allowed to write INSTEAD OF naming each registered file. Declaring one asserts nothing on its own: declared_artwork_scopes / _assert_declared_scopes_hold_only_registered_artwork expand each scope against the real tree and refuse it if ANY artwork file under it is not one of the seven registered assets. That check is what makes a glob safe to write in a grant sentence - it can only ever stand for registered works - and it is re-run at preflight, so dropping an eighth raster into one of these directories blocks the release instead of silently widening the grant.

ccby_excluded_scope._note: Categories the artwork activation may NEVER extend CC BY over. Counting third-party rights tokens proves they were not DELETED; it does not prove the activation did not ADD a CC BY claim over them. For each token below, the number of sentences asserting CC BY alongside it must not increase.

third_party_rights_tokens: Contains modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information
Neither the European Commission nor ECMWF is responsible

validator_verdict._note: The shipped validate_deposit.py prints '[ok] ...' lines and ends with a BARE terminal verdict line. Measured against the real deposit: exit 0, 66 non-empty lines, last line exactly 'PASS', one PASS occurrence, zero FAIL. Counting substrings is not enough - 'BYPASS' and 'COMPASS' both contain 'PASS'. The verdict is therefore an ANCHORED whole-line match, it must be the LAST non-empty line, and exactly one verdict line may appear in the whole output.

licence_block_replacement._note: The deposit's own LICENSE.txt is the only licence surface whose authored destination block is a different SIZE from the block it retires: the activated notice runs exactly two lines longer, 13 lines becoming 15. Every tracked record is held to an unchanged line count by _assert_structure_preserved, so without this declaration the deposit's legal notice would be the only surface whose rewrite had no pinned size at all - and it is the surface with the most to lose, carrying the section 0 path table, the MIT grant over validate_deposit.py, and the Copernicus and GHCN-Daily notices the authors have no power to relicense. expected_line_delta is NOT the contract's to choose: release_finalizer.py pins ARCHIVE_LICENCE_EXPECTED_LINE_DELTA and requires this declaration to EQUAL it, so editing this file cannot license a larger rewrite of the deposit's legal notice than the one that was reviewed. adjacent_anchors names passages that must lie OUTSIDE the replaced block and survive it at an unchanged count; each is verified to be outside, because a source block that grew to swallow the Copernicus notice would otherwise be free to rewrite it and still pass every other check.

ccby_activation_plan.authored_by: Fawaz Bouhamad, drafted for Dr. Nasser Najibi's review and authorization

ccby_activation_plan.note: AUTHORED BUT INACTIVE. The from/to pairs below are a DRAFT of a future edit, written by Fawaz Bouhamad and awaiting Dr. Nasser Najibi's review and authorization. Drafting them is not Dr. Najibi's act and records no approval by them: until a coauthor approval is resolved from one of the two discriminated approval_sources - the preferred external_evidence route, or the retained github_pr_comment route - and the receipt at authorization_receipt.tracked_path exists and validates, every licence record still withholds the grant and this repository is PENDING. artwork_licence_markers.active is filled in alongside the plan so the classifier can recognise the new wording; registering a marker asserts nothing either. Activating CC BY over the Figure 1 / Figure 4 artwork rewrites legal prose in the four licence records AND in the archive's own LICENSE.txt, so the finalizer will not invent that prose: with authored=false it stops with CCBY_ACTIVATION_PLAN_UNAUTHORED. The plan must cover ALL FIVE licence surfaces - the four tracked records plus the archive member LICENSE.txt - or it is rejected as partial. The finalizer then applies the pairs with the same structured, count-checked, transactional machinery it uses for the archive identity, and independently asserts that no third-party rights token changed and that the activation identifies no Licensed Material outside ccby_artwork_paths and the verified ccby_artwork_scope_globs. REVISING THIS WORDING IS NO LONGER A CONTRACT EDIT ALONE. Each of the five destination blocks, the active publication row, the active marker and authorization.text is pinned BY SHA-256 in REVIEWED_ACTIVATION_DESTINATIONS and its companions in scripts/release/release_finalizer.py, so an edit here that is not accompanied by a re-review and a matching code-owned digest is refused as CCBY_ACTIVATION_DESTINATION_UNREVIEWED, at preflight and again before any activation is planned. That is deliberate: a prose guard only refuses what somebody anticipated, and a digest refuses everything else.

While that receipt is absent every real licence record still withholds the grant and the repository state is PENDING. Authoring this plan grants nothing and asserts nothing.
